title: OdysseyArena: Benchmarking Large Language Models For Long-Horizon, Active and Inductive Interactions
abstract: arXiv:2602.05843v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has catalyzed the development of autonomous agents capable of navigating complex environments. However, existing evaluations primarily adopt a deductive paradigm, where agents execute tasks based on explicitly provided rules and static goals, often within limited planning horizons. Crucially, this neglects the inductive necessity for agents to discover latent transition laws from experience autonomously, which is the cornerstone for enabling agentic foresight and sustaining strategic coherence. translated_title: OdysseyArena：面向长时程、主动与归纳式交互的大语言模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的发展催生了能够在复杂环境中自主导航的智能体。然而，现有的评估主要采用演绎范式，即智能体基于显式给定的规则和静态目标来执行任务，且规划时域往往有限。至关重要的是，这忽略了智能体需要自主地从经验中发现潜在转换规律的归纳必要性，而这是实现智能体前瞻能力并维持策略连贯性的基石。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了OdysseyArena，将智能体评估重新聚焦于长时程、主动和归纳式交互。我们形式化并实例化了四个基元，将抽象的转换动态转化为具体的交互环境。在此基础上，我们建立了用于标准化基准测试的OdysseyArena-Lite，提供了一组120个任务来衡量智能体的归纳（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出OdysseyArena基准，通过形式化四个基元将智能体评估重新聚焦于长时程、主动和归纳式交互，并建立包含120个任务的OdysseyArena-Lite来衡量智能体从经验中自主发现潜在转换规律的能力。
en_tdlr: OdysseyArena re-centers LLM agent evaluation on long-horizon, active, and inductive interactions, formalizing four primitives and providing OdysseyArena-Lite with 120 tasks to measure agents' ability to autonomously discover latent transition laws from experience.
